newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges stable, cargoes easy, arb shut.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges stable, cargoes easy, arb shut.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady on Thursday and Eurograde barges were heard to have traded at $190 a tonne fob ARA, versus trades on Wednesday at $190 and $191.
Dealers said that the arbitrage window to the United States, based on closing prices in New York on Wednesday, was still some $5-$7 a tonne apart.
But one dealer felt that this was putting pressure on cargo prices and these were sinking relative to barges, which were supported by good buying from a trade house.
Cargo numbers were hard to pin down and while some players said cif prices were three or four dollars above barges, others felt they were approaching parity.
